data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 tons total each month and leave 50 to replenish it. How about 10 tons each? That’s $10,000 apiece every month without depleting the lake. I’ll stick to that limit if we all agree, and we can review everyone’s catches together each month. John, what do you think?
